taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: ASP.NET Core Data Protection key-ring and purpose isolation
controls.source_trace: Trace which applications/tenants share keys and purposes and whether one protected payload is accepted in another authorization context.
controls.implementation_branch: Shared keys and application names can deliberately enable SSO. Compare intended security domains, application discriminator and the full purpose chain, plus key-ring read/write authority. Unprotect success alone is not an authorization grant: verify how the consumer interprets tenant, identity and purpose before asserting that another application can impersonate a protected user.
controls.controlled_verification: Use two local owned apps with synthetic protected tokens; compare intended unprotect and a cross-app/purpose attempt.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Sharing a key ring can be intentional for a single security boundary; successful decryption is not a privilege grant unless the consumer accepts the payload context.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Separate key access/purposes according to the intended boundary and retest legitimate migration and token use.
